retirements.reason: Standing rule D-252: the verdict reads the zero percent sum of published positions as an extraction gap because the schedule prints a total percent. The filing tags percent of net assets only on sector contexts (industry plus issuer category plus debt type) and the totals, never on a position context, and prints no percent on any position line (it follows each industry subtotal). No published row's context carries a percent fact and none publishes one, so nothing per position was dropped; the check also fails when a percent fact is planted on a published position context. Sandbox dize.
